## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Change type

- [ ] Assessment or routing logic
- [ ] Business-case model
- [ ] Infrastructure or migration guidance
- [ ] Validation or modernization asset
- [ ] Documentation or enablement

## Validation

List the commands, scenarios, or evidence used to validate the change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I used only synthetic or non-sensitive data.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, connection strings, or tenant-specific identifiers.
- [ ] I verified time-sensitive product, pricing, API, and support claims against current official documentation.
- [ ] I updated directly related documentation.
- [ ] I considered security, rollback, and backward compatibility.
